title: Can I have custom reset button for searchbox?
body: I need custom reset button to reset my searchbox. How can I have that?  I want write my own button for that.

comments.body: You can use the `reset` option on the `SearchBox`. You can specify a custom template for this. You can find more informations about that [in our documentation](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/searchBox.html#struct-SearchBoxResetOption).
Thanks @samouss , Is there any way that another button trigger reset ?
You can use the `connectSearchBox` connector if you want to customise it even further, or use the `clearAll` widget with `clearsQuery: true`
